references.text: The priest dips his finger in the blood and sprinkles it seven times before the Lord, in front of the curtain to the sanctuary. The same ritual of sprinkling seven times before the Lord.
The priest dips his finger in the blood and sprinkles seven times before the Lord. A parallel action involving sprinkling seven times.
Sprinkling seven times as part of the cleansing ritual for leprosy. The same context of purification and the number seven.
The priest sprinkles some of the oil with his right finger seven times before the Lord. An almost identical ritual described later in the same chapter.
Moses sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times. Use of oil and sprinkling seven times in a consecration ritual.
Anointing oil is poured over the head as part of priestly ordination. Use of holy oil in priestly ceremonies.
The priest takes some of the blood with his finger and sprinkles it toward the front of the tent sanctuary seven times. A parallel ritual involving sprinkling seven times.
